Muay Thai near Cheshunt

Cheshunt is home ground for part of our team, and Warrior Spirit in Potters Bar is only 15 to 20 minutes away.

Book your free first class →Timetable
Why Cheshunt members train here

Worth every mile

It’s worth the trip for what you can’t easily get closer to home: a fight team with a clear path from interclubs to amateur and semi-pro, structured fight camps, and coaches who corner you on the night.

  • Beginners class every Thursday at 7pm
  • Kids Muay Thai, ages 7 to 13, Monday to Thursday
  • Adults £75 a month, all inclusive
  • 1-to-1 personal training from £40 an hour
  • A fight team from interclubs to semi-pro

Tip Thinking of competing? Talk to us about the fight team. Cheshunt fighters train the same camps as everyone else.

Cheshunt questions

Is it worth travelling from Cheshunt?
